analysis.primaryGoal: Drive interest and orders of gift boxes, gift bags, and a Mystery Box promotion.
analysis.audience: B2B customers interested in packaging, gifting solutions, and branded merchandise.
analysis.offer: Gratis Mystery Box with purchase, promotional highlighting of gift packaging and branded bags.

visualStyle.imageStyle: Well-lit professional product photography, mix of group and close-up images, clean compositional backgrounds

copyStyle.tone: Conversational with a touch of festivity and exclusivity
copyStyle.urgency: Moderate (invites action but not high pressure; supported by limited kit availability/pricing).

reusablePatterns: Intro section framing the value emotionally
Alternating blocks: visual focus, explanatory caption
Clusters of product images for range visualization
Tiered product/kit upsell path with clear pricing
Multiple bold CTAs aligned with each section's focus
risks: Possible confusion if the Mystery Box mechanics/rules are unclear.
Potential lack of clarity if users are unfamiliar with DIY Kit value.
Danish-only copy may not engage audiences outside DK.

confidence.notes: Text, structure, and wording are almost fully clear except for minor details in small print/blurred kit images. Copy and design patterns are confidently identified.
